hypothesis: Building on c018 (cap 3.92, TNS-heavy, score +0.505, best so far), the cap is already the only active lever in this patch; nudge it modestly downward by x0.7 to ~2.74 so weight concentrates further on the most-critical nets and spreads moderate-violation reduction, confirming whether the trend of tighter caps continues to help TNS without harming legality.
analysis: The hypothesis held: tightening the cap to ~2.74 improved TNS across all three cases (dTNS +1.2% to +17.7%) with all runs valid, confirming the tighter-cap trend. Gains are broadest on bp_fe-ng45 (score +0.141, dTNS +17.7%) and bp-ng45 (+11.9%), consistent with concentrating weight on critical nets while still reducing moderate violations; ariane133-ng45 shows only marginal TNS (+1.2%) despite strong dWNS (+17.4%), suggesting its TNS is dominated by many moderate nets the tighter cap under-serves. Next step: test an intermediate cap (~3.2) or a case-adaptive cap to recover ariane's TNS without losing the bp gains.
